boundary: Aggregation root through FRI compression, both staging and KZG proving phases, and in-process verification. Root generation is excluded; additional CPU verification is reported separately.

focused_tests.large_msm_timing_scope: Correctness test; CPU-only tests were running concurrently, so its timing is not an isolated benchmark.

limitations: One-trace diagnostics are not whole-pipeline measurements.
Host coefficients are retained for checkpoints and spill recovery.
Lookup and constraint evaluation still run on the CPU and require downloaded row-major evaluations.
Fixed cache identity binds the exact executable and the recursive public statement.
The conservative half-VRAM budget holds about 160 GiB of recursive coefficients and leaves four large columns on the host. This is bounded coefficient residency, not a fully device-only prover.
Coarse utilization samples miss short kernels; phase samples and overlapping per-operation event intervals are both retained.
Known-trapdoor development SRS only. The benchmark uses the regenerated 19-circuit Init FRI profile.

Resident-input coset FFTs, MSMs and batched-point evaluation
Per-device byte admission with host-backed spill recovery
Parallel affine conversion and scalar normalization
Per-operation CUDA transfer and compute-interval profiling
